Text: DeepSeek published the models, the harness and the 88-page paper under it, then kept every researcher off camera

This one talked for 59 minutes, and he explains why your agent gets dumber the longer you run it

19:04 - agents already past the self-improvement line
20:11 - why an agent wiped its folder
29:45 - why retrying makes RL models worse
41:05 - how they measured reasoning collapse
46:01 - the fix that made training faster

He co-authored DeepSeek-V2 and published the training methods behind R1

Watch it before it goes the way of the founder's four-hour speech
